title: Paper planes
examples: How do I make my paper plane fly farther?
What makes a paper plane glide well?
Do I need to fold it perfectly?

explain.say: Today we are learning about making paper planes fly.
First we look at the wings of the plane.
Next we practice the folding part carefully.
When you throw it, you must throw gently.

draw.text: Gentle throw keeps the plane steady.

explain.say: The last step is watching it glide through the air.

draw.text: Gliding shows the plane's best flight.

explain.say: In real life, planes use these same ideas to fly.

faq.a: They glide because the wings catch the air and keep pushing the plane forward slowly.
asks: How do I make it go far?

faq.q: Should the wings be big or small?
faq.a: The wings need to be big enough to catch the air but not too big to make it heavy.

faq.q: Is it okay if my folds are not perfect?
faq.a: It is okay if they are not perfect, but try to make the folds as straight as you can for best flight.
asks: Do they have to be straight?

faq.q: Do I need to throw it hard?
faq.a: No, throwing it too hard makes it wobble and fall down quickly.
asks: Should I throw it like a baseball?

faq.q: What is the best way to fold it?
faq.a: There are many ways, but folding it into a simple dart shape works very well to start with.
asks: Can you show me the best fold?

facts: Wings help create lift when air moves over them.
Folding helps give the plane a strong, stable shape.
A gentle throw helps the plane glide smoothly.
Gliding means moving through the air without falling.

quiz.say: What part of the plane catches the air to help it fly?
quiz.why: The wings are designed to catch the air and create lift.

wrong.1: The nose just points the plane forward and does not catch air.
wrong.2: The body is mostly for holding the wings together, not for lift.
wrong.3: You do not use your fingers when the plane is flying.

quiz.say: If I throw the plane too hard, what usually happens?
quiz.why: A gentle throw keeps the plane stable and gliding for longer.

wrong.0: The force helps it start, but too much force is bad.
wrong.2: Throwing too hard usually makes the plane unstable.
wrong.3: Too much force can cause it to shake side to side.

quiz.say: When folding, what should you aim for?
quiz.why: Straight folds make the wings strong and help the plane fly true.

wrong.1: Messy folds create weak spots where the plane might break.
wrong.2: You must fold the wings too for it to fly well.
wrong.3: A ball shape will not glide through the air.
